items.authors: Alexander Sun, Joshua J. Park, David DeTomaso, Seoyeon Kim, Amelia Liu, Suyash Shringarpure, Kenny Kim, Patrick C. Thompson, Tuo Shi, Yunyun Wang, Eran A. Mukamel, Grace X. Y. Zheng, Y. Joy Jiao, Xin Jin (Scripps Research, OpenAI, PerturbAI, UC San Diego, HHMI)

title.zh: FARMS：把数值数学教材变成保留适用条件的 Lean 陈述，每个目标约 1–2 美元
title.en: FARMS: Turning Numerical-Math Textbooks Into Lean Statements That Keep Their Conditions, at About $1–2 per Target

why.zh: 把数值数学教材转成保留原始适用条件的 Lean 陈述，能以每个目标约 1–2 美元的成本给自动化科学智能体提供可检查的保证，因为每条形式化都要经过忠实性审查，而不只是能编译通过。
why.en: Turning numerical-math textbooks into Lean statements that keep their source conditions gives automated-science agents checkable guarantees for about $1–2 per target, because each formalization is reviewed for faithfulness rather than merely compiling.

what.zh: 自动化计算科学需要 AI 能复用的数学保证，但只看编译是否通过的自动形式化会高估质量，还可能丢掉决定某个保证是否适用的前提（采样方式、边界条件、误差范数）。
what.en: Automated computational science needs mathematical guarantees that AI can reuse, but autoformalization judged by compilation alone overstates quality and can drop the premises (sampling scheme, boundary conditions, error norm) that decide whether a guarantee applies.

how.zh: FARMS 先为每个目标整理包含定义、假设和算法描述的源材料包，再借助可复用的领域表示做形式化，然后经过编译、语义审查和有限次修复；在随机数值线性代数与数值 PDE 的四个来源（Drineas–Mahoney、Halko–Martinsson–Tropp、Martinsson–Tropp、Larsson–Thomée）共 171 个目标中，157 个被流程接受，各来源平均估算成本为每个目标 0.85–2.29 美元。在随机抽取的 6 个目标上，FARMS 估算每个目标 2.84 美元，而作者对 AutoformBot 的陈述级改编版需 58.02 美元；Lean 检查过的蕴含关系把选定陈述连成计算技能，用于稳态热传导求解和波响应库压缩，不过目前只覆盖四个来源，发现新方法仍是开放问题。
how.en: FARMS first prepares a source package of definitions, assumptions and algorithm descriptions for each target, formalizes it with reusable domain representations, then runs compilation, semantic review and bounded repair; across 171 targets from four sources in randomized numerical linear algebra and numerical PDEs (Drineas–Mahoney, Halko–Martinsson–Tropp, Martinsson–Tropp, Larsson–Thomée), 157 were accepted by the pipeline at mean estimated costs of US$0.85–2.29 per target across sources. On six randomly selected targets FARMS cost an estimated US$2.84 per target against US$58.02 for the authors' statement-level adaptation of AutoformBot, and Lean-checked implications link selected statements into computational skills used in a steady heat-flow solve and wave-response library compression, though coverage is four sources and discovering new methods remains open.

metric.en: 157/171 accepted · US$0.85–2.29 per target · US$2.84 vs 58.02

items.authors: Di Wu, Ling Liang, Haizhao Yang (University of Maryland, University of Tennessee Knoxville)

title.zh: Outerloop：autoresearch 系统报告的提升里有一截是运气，把测量搬到 agent 沙盒之外才算数
title.en: Outerloop: Part of Every Autoresearch Gain Is Luck Until Measurement Moves Outside the Agent's Sandbox

why.zh: 让 agent 自己给自己的实验打分的 autoresearch 系统会系统性地夸大提升，因为它们从许多单种子的噪声运行里挑出最好的一次，报告的分数里就包含了那次的运气；而由内核在 agent 看不到的新种子上重新测量后，记入的提升与独立审计基本一致。
why.en: Autoresearch systems that let agents grade their own experiments systematically overstate their gains, because they pick the best of many noisy single-seed runs and the reported number carries that run's luck, while a kernel that re-measures on seeds the agent never sees credits gains that match an independent audit.

what.zh: 现有开源 autoresearch 系统（如 Karpathy 的 autoresearch、AIDE、ShinkaEvolve）里，agent 既写改动又评估改动，于是选择偏差、篡改评测代码、以及“分数是真的但改法不可接受”这三类问题都没人把关，而且搜索越大越容易出现。
what.en: In current open autoresearch systems such as Karpathy's autoresearch, AIDE and ShinkaEvolve, the agent both writes and evaluates its changes, leaving selection bias, tampering with evaluation code and real-but-unacceptable gains unchecked, and larger searches make all three more likely.

how.zh: Outerloop（纽约大学 Mengye Ren）像操作系统内核一样把 agent 当作不可信程序放进沙盒：只能改约定的文件，内核用自己抽取的隐藏种子背靠背测量基线和候选、超过噪声下限（这里 64 步，约 3%）才记功，再由两个只读评审 agent 检查作弊和改动归因，只有内核能推送；在 nanoGPT 训练提速基准、GLM 5.2、48 GPU 小时的对比中，ShinkaEvolve、AIDE、autoresearch 平均多报 83、45、45 步，而 Outerloop 为 −4，关掉内核测量让自家 agent 自报时也多报 36 步，120 个记功结果中 118 个（98%）被三种子审计确认。作者也指出，各系统用同一模型时最终分数相近，差距几乎都来自是否想起 Muon 优化器，所以这更多衡量的是“回忆已知技巧”而非新发现，验证约占研究 GPU 时间的五分之一，且只用了一个高噪声的小基准。
how.en: Outerloop (Mengye Ren, NYU) runs agents as untrusted sandboxed programs like an operating-system kernel: they may edit only contracted files, the kernel measures base and candidate back to back on its own hidden seed and credits only gains above a noise floor (64 steps, about 3%), two read-only judge agents check for gaming and attribution, and only the kernel can push; on a nanoGPT training-speed benchmark with GLM 5.2 and 48 GPU-hours, ShinkaEvolve, AIDE and autoresearch over-claimed by 83, 45 and 45 steps on average versus −4 for Outerloop, its own agents over-claimed by 36 steps when the kernel measurement was switched off, and 118 of 120 credited results (98%) were confirmed by a three-seed audit. The authors note that with the same model the systems reach similar final scores and the difference comes almost entirely from recalling the Muon optimizer, so the benchmark measures recall of known tricks more than discovery, verification took about a fifth of the GPU-hours, and only one small, noisy benchmark was used.

metric.zh: 多报：ShinkaEvolve +83 步 vs Outerloop −4 · 审计确认 118/120
metric.en: Over-claim: ShinkaEvolve +83 steps vs Outerloop −4 · audit confirms 118/120

items.authors: Mengye Ren (Agentic Learning AI Lab, New York University)

title.zh: Your Policy Is Secretly a Harness：用冻结模型比较 harness 会错杀更好的 harness
title.en: Your Policy Is Secretly a Harness: Comparing Harnesses with a Frozen Model Rejects Better Ones

why.zh: 用同一个已训练好的模型给候选 harness 打分会系统性地错杀更好的 harness，因为后训练把模型的动作偏好绑死在训练时的 harness 上，换个 harness 时它先损失的“失配”在继续训练后大多能消掉，而新 harness 抬高的“上限”才是长期收益。
why.en: Scoring candidate harnesses with one already-trained model systematically rejects better harnesses, because post-training ties the model's action preferences to its training harness, so the mismatch it suffers after a switch mostly disappears with further training while the higher ceiling the new harness offers is the lasting gain.

what.zh: 自动 harness 设计通常用固定模型在每个候选 harness 下的表现来打分，这默认模型在旧 harness 下学到的东西能直接迁移到新 harness。
what.en: Automated harness design usually scores each candidate by how a fixed model performs under it, which assumes what the model learned under earlier harnesses carries over to the new one.

how.zh: 作者（香港科技大学（广州））在 KL 正则控制下证明部署回报恰好等于 harness 的上限减去策略的失配（沿自身轨迹累积的与最优策略的 KL），训练只改失配、换 harness 两者都改：在 MiniWoB++ 上用 Qwen3.5-2B 做实验，只是把观测 JSON 的字段顺序反过来、所有最优决策都不变，训练好的模型成功率就从 85.0% 掉到 19.2%；冻结比较否决、但抬高上限的 7 个 harness 换法在同等预算继续训练后全部超过原 agent，事先测得的“上限减失配”预测收益的 Spearman ρ=0.95（冻结回报变化只有 0.17）。在 5 个编码 agent harness（DeepAgents、Pi、DeepSeek Harness、Terminus-2、mini-SWE-agent）上，同一个冻结 Qwen3.5-9B 的 Terminal-Bench Lite 准确率在 47.9%–64.1% 之间，用更强的教师模型代替最优策略估计的“上限减失配”能把 5 个 harness 的顺序全部排对，而任一单项都会排错；不过机制实验都在小模型和可求解的小任务上。
how.en: The authors (HKUST Guangzhou) prove under KL-regularized control that deployed return equals the harness's ceiling minus the policy's mismatch (its KL from the optimal policy accumulated along its own trajectories), so training moves only the mismatch while a harness change moves both: on MiniWoB++ with Qwen3.5-2B, just reversing the order of the observation JSON fields, which leaves every optimal decision unchanged, drops a trained model's success from 85.0% to 19.2%, and all 7 harness swaps that a frozen comparison rejects but that raise the ceiling beat the original agent after equal further training, with ceiling minus mismatch measured beforehand predicting the gains at Spearman ρ=0.95 against 0.17 for the frozen return change. Across five coding-agent harnesses (DeepAgents, Pi, DeepSeek Harness, Terminus-2, mini-SWE-agent) a frozen Qwen3.5-9B ranges from 47.9% to 64.1% on Terminal-Bench Lite, and ceiling minus mismatch estimated with a stronger teacher in place of the optimum orders all five correctly while either term alone misorders them, although the mechanism experiments use small models and small solvable tasks.

metric.en: Field reversal 85.0%→19.2% · gain prediction ρ=0.95 vs 0.17

pills.zh: 被否决但抬高上限的换法
pills.en: Rejected swaps that raise the ceiling

items.authors: Jian Mu, Ruibo Shen, Yao Shu (HKUST Guangzhou, HKUST)

title.zh: KARMA：只进化带编号的知识规则、不动代码，广告 agent 留出集提升 +8.96 分
title.en: KARMA: Evolving Only Numbered Knowledge Rules, Not Code, Lifts Ad-Agent Hold-Out Scores by 8.96 Points

why.zh: 把 agent 的可改部分限制在六类带编号的知识规则上、每轮最多三条原子修改且验证集提升不足 1 分就整体回滚，同时让 Critic 对比成功和失败轨迹，能在不改权重和代码的情况下稳定提分，因为只看失败的修补容易把原本做对的决策也改坏，成功案例告诉它哪些规则该保留。
why.en: Restricting what an agent may change to six typed modules of numbered knowledge rules, allowing at most three atomic edits per round and rolling everything back when the validation gain is under one point, while a Critic compares successful and failed trajectories, reliably raises scores without touching weights or code, because repairs driven only by failures tend to break decisions that were already right and the successes show which rules to keep.

what.zh: 工业广告 agent 的预算、出价和商品决策规则会随商品、流量和政策变化而过时，整段重写 prompt 难以追溯每处改动，大范围改 harness 代码又难以验证和回滚。
what.en: Budget, bid and item rules for industrial advertising agents go stale as products, traffic and policies change, whole-prompt rewrites make individual changes hard to trace, and broad harness-code edits are hard to validate and roll back.

how.zh: KARMA（阿里巴巴国际数字商业集团）用确定性的 Trace Verifier 把错误映射到候选知识模块，Critic 对比成败轨迹提出修改，受工具约束的 Evolver 写入带出处的原子编辑，在约 50 万条真实 AliExpress 运营日志抽样的 6 个领域、3 个模型家族（Qwen3.8-Max、GLM-5.3、Kimi-K3）共 18 种设置上把平均留出分从 30.19 提到 39.15（+8.96，+29.7%），16 种设置提升；去掉成功或失败任一证据都会让平均留出提升减半以上（+16.67 降到 +8.23 / +6.56），同一门控下也胜过 GEPA、AHE 和 Self-Harness。冻结后的知识跨领域迁移平均 +8.54 分，但汽车领域进化出的知识会拉低所有其他领域，Kimi-K3 在两个领域退步；评测是离线与历史操作的一致率，不代表收入等真实业务效果，每个主设置只跑一次。
how.en: KARMA (Alibaba International Digital Commerce Group) uses a deterministic Trace Verifier to map errors to candidate knowledge modules, a Critic that contrasts successful and failed trajectories to propose changes, and a tool-constrained Evolver that writes atomic edits with provenance, raising the average hold-out score across 18 settings (6 domains sampled from about half a million real AliExpress operation logs × 3 model families: Qwen3.8-Max, GLM-5.3, Kimi-K3) from 30.19 to 39.15 (+8.96, +29.7%) and improving 16 of them; removing either successes or failures more than halves the average hold-out gain (+16.67 down to +8.23 or +6.56), and under the same gate it beats GEPA, AHE and Self-Harness. Frozen knowledge transfers across domains for an average +8.54, but knowledge evolved on Automotive lowers every other domain and Kimi-K3 regresses in two domains, and evaluation is offline agreement with logged actions rather than revenue, with each main setting run once.

metric.en: Hold-out 30.19→39.15 (+29.7%) · 16 of 18 settings improve

items.authors: Xinhua Miao, Yuanzhen Rong, Weiru Zhang, Xiaoyi Zeng (Alibaba International Digital Commerce Group)

title.zh: 让 AI 自己提出研究问题：5 次连续运行全部写出可复算论文，但新颖性仍是短板
title.en: Letting AI Formulate the Research Question: Five Straight Runs Produce Re-Computable Papers, but Novelty Stays Weak

why.zh: 只给一个普通编码 agent 一份说明文档和两个技能、人类只用一两句话划定研究领域，它就能自己提出问题并做成经过复核、可复算的论文，但领域那一两句话基本决定了它研究什么，而真正卡住的是挑出“答案重要且不由设计决定”的问题，而不是执行实验。
why.en: Given only an instruction document and two skills, with a human setting the research area in one or two sentences, an off-the-shelf coding agent can pose its own question and carry it to a reviewed, re-computable paper, but those one or two sentences largely decide what it studies, and the real bottleneck is choosing a question whose answer matters and is not fixed by the design, not running the experiments.

what.zh: The AI Scientist 等演示中，研究领域和最后展示哪些产出仍由人选，于是 AI 自己选题的能力和问题一直看不到。
what.en: In demonstrations like The AI Scientist, humans still chose the research area and which outputs to show, so how well AI chooses its own questions stayed invisible.

how.zh: 作者（大妻女子大学 Ko Fujimura）让 Codex CLI（gpt-6.1-sol）按选题技能先从 2024 年后的新技术发散到其他领域写出至少 12 个候选、按 6 项检查筛掉“装饰性用技术”“答案由定义决定”“无公开真值”等问题，再请另一模型批评前 5 名，并由 Claude Code（Opus 5.5）根据记录复跑研究后审稿；冻结系统后连续 5 次运行全部在笔记本电脑上从选题走到修订稿，无人类研究输入，共写出 77 个候选问题（全是社会或环境议题），评审复跑了每份初稿并复现了数字，40 条意见全部采纳或部分采纳，批评者每次都改变了比较和测量方式但从未改变选中的问题。外部 AI 评审（Gemini 4 Argon、Muse Wonder）认为论文在研讨会水平或边缘、低于主会，新颖性 3.0/2.2、通用性 2.6/2.0 偏低，20 份评审中 19 份认为主要答案“部分可由设计预测”，5 份中 2 份结论为阴性或无效；样本小、无消融，评价全部来自 AI。
how.en: The author (Ko Fujimura, Otsuma Women's University) has Codex CLI (gpt-6.1-sol) follow a question skill that diverges from post-2024 technologies into other fields to write at least 12 candidates, screens them with six checks against decorative technology use, answers fixed by definitions and missing public ground truth, asks a different model to critique the top five, and has Claude Code (Opus 5.5) re-run the study from its records before reviewing; after freezing the system, all five consecutive runs went from question to revised paper on a laptop with no human research input, writing 77 candidate questions (all societal or environmental), the reviewer re-ran every first draft and reproduced the numbers, all 40 findings were adopted or partly adopted, and the critic changed how the chosen question was compared or measured every time but never changed which question was chosen. External AI reviewers (Gemini 4 Argon, Muse Wonder) judged the papers workshop-level or borderline and below main track, with low novelty (3.0 and 2.2) and generality (2.6 and 2.0), 19 of 20 reviews found the main answer partly predictable from the design, and 2 of 5 results are negative or null, with a small sample, no ablations and only AI evaluations.

metric.zh: 5/5 运行完成无人干预 · 77 个候选问题 · 外部评审：研讨会水平
metric.en: 5/5 runs complete with no human input · 77 candidate questions · external review: workshop level

items.authors: Ko Fujimura (Otsuma Women's University)

title.zh: VERSE：让 harness 优化器先跑通草稿再提交，自我进化才真正起作用
title.en: VERSE: Self-Evolving Harness Optimizers Only Help Once They Test Draft Edits Before Submitting

why.zh: 让 harness 优化器同时改写自己的提示、技能和工具，只有在它能先在训练任务上实际运行草稿修改时才会提分，因为光靠读轨迹写下的“经验”大多没被验证，十条预测会修好的修复里只有一条在下一轮真的通过。
why.en: Letting a harness optimizer also rewrite its own prompts, skills and tools only raises scores when it can actually run draft edits on training tasks first, because lessons written from reading trajectories are mostly unverified and only about 1 in 10 fixes it predicts actually pass in the next round.

what.zh: 现有 harness 优化器（如 Meta-Harness）只改执行器的 harness，自身的诊断和验证流程固定不变，而直接允许它自我进化时，6 轮中没有一轮超过初始 harness（31.79，低于不进化的 39.20）。
what.en: Existing harness optimizers such as Meta-Harness only edit the executor's harness while their own diagnosis and testing procedures stay fixed, and simply allowing self-evolution made no round beat the initial harness (31.79 against 39.20 without it).

how.zh: VERSE（MIT、Amazon）让优化器在提交前测试草稿、重放失败并扰动可疑步骤，同时跨轮跟踪修复与回归，优化器（Qwen3.8-Flash-Next）和执行器（Qwen3.8-27B）权重都冻结，在 SWE-rebench 留出的 108 个 Python 任务上最佳 harness 达 42.3%（最强基线 39.2%），在 2026 年 7 月 5 种语言的 107 个分布外新任务上达 37.7%（基线 29.3%），并在 16 组对比中全部超过宿主方法 0.6–10.3 分，而去掉自我进化时有 8 组反而低于基线。审计显示已提交的修改修好了 148 个验证任务却也弄坏了 134 个，约一半结果变化无法复现，自我进化的优化器会给 34/81 份草稿加回归检查（不进化时 2/89）；每行只跑一次进化，成本也更高。
how.en: VERSE (MIT and Amazon) lets the optimizer test drafts, replay failures and perturb suspected steps before submitting while tracking fixes and regressions across rounds, with both optimizer (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next) and executor (Qwen3.8-27B) weights frozen, and its best harness reaches 42.3% on 108 held-out SWE-rebench Python tasks (strongest baseline 39.2%) and 37.7% on 107 newer July 2026 out-of-distribution tasks in five languages (baseline 29.3%), beating its host method in all 16 comparisons by 0.6–10.3 points while dropping below baseline in 8 of 16 without self-evolution. Audits show submitted edits fixed 148 validation tasks but broke 134, about half of outcome changes did not reproduce, and self-evolving optimizers added regression checks to 34 of 81 drafts (2 of 89 without), with only one evolution run per row and higher cost.

metric.zh: SWE-rebench 留出 42.3% · 分布外 37.7% · 16/16 组对比提升
metric.en: SWE-rebench held-out 42.3% · OOD 37.7% · 16/16 comparisons improved

items.authors: Zekai Wang, Yingqiang Ge, Zekun Wang, Hai Wang, Yuhui Xu, Joshua Frandsen, Shancong Fu, Ashia C. Wilson, Chandan K. Reddy (MIT, Amazon)

title.zh: Harness²：不靠标准答案，用对照探测在测试时递归改进 agent harness
title.en: Harness²: Recursively Improving Agent Harnesses at Test Time Without Ground-Truth Verifiers

why.zh: 在没有标准答案的新任务上，先提出几种 harness 修改、在相同条件下实际运行对比、只保留有行为证据支持的改动，就能稳定提分，而把这些改进过程的经验写进库里还能帮助后续任务，因为可复用的是“怎么诊断和验证修改”，而不是某个任务专用的 harness 本身。
why.en: On new tasks without reference answers, proposing several harness edits, running them side by side under matched conditions and keeping only changes backed by behavioral evidence reliably raises scores, and logging lessons from that process into a library also helps later tasks, because what transfers is how to diagnose and test edits rather than any one task-specific harness.

what.zh: 开放世界里的任务事先没见过、也没有可靠验证器来指导在线修改 harness，而直接沿用为上一个任务高度定制的 harness 往往在需求变化后失效。
what.en: Open-world tasks are unseen in advance and lack reliable verifiers to guide online harness edits, and directly inheriting a harness tailored to the previous task often fails once requirements shift.

how.zh: Harness²（Google Research）在任务层用 Propose–Probe–Compose 对照步骤提出通用与领域修改、探测其效果再组合，并可并行或串行递归，在 harness 层把有对照证据支持的经验写入改进库，单步即让 GLM-5 在 WorkBuddy-Bench 上从 64.2 升到 75.7（+11.5，超过原 harness 下的 Gemini 3.5 Flash），JobBench 最多 +4.5 分、Harvey LAB 部分通过率最多 +11.8 pp，k=5 并行递归再加 2.9–3.9、3.0–4.2 和 2.6–6.7。消融显示去掉经验库在两个基准上分别掉 3.1 和 1.8 分，不给对照证据直接改 harness 会让 Code 从 73.4 跌到 63.2，执行器和编辑器用同一模型时 5 个模型（从 GLM-5 到 Claude Opus 5）在每个基准上都有提升。
how.en: Harness² (Google Research) uses a contrastive Propose–Probe–Compose step at task level to propose invariant and domain edits, probe their effects and compose the supported ones, with parallel or sequential recursion, and at harness level writes evidence-backed lessons into an improvement library, so a single step lifts GLM-5 on WorkBuddy-Bench from 64.2 to 75.7 (+11.5, above Gemini 3.5 Flash on its original harness), JobBench by up to +4.5 and Harvey LAB partial pass rate by up to +11.8 pp, with k=5 parallel recursion adding 2.9–3.9, 3.0–4.2 and 2.6–6.7 more. Ablations show removing the library costs 3.1 and 1.8 points on the two benchmarks, editing the harness directly without contrast evidence drops Code from 73.4 to 63.2, and with the same model as executor and editor all five models from GLM-5 to Claude Opus 5 improve on every benchmark.

metric.zh: 单步 WorkBuddy +11.5 · LAB +11.8 pp · 无需标准答案
metric.en: One step WorkBuddy +11.5 · LAB +11.8 pp · no ground truth needed

items.authors: Ruiyao Xu, Yanfei Chen, Zhongying CuiZhu, Bhavana Dalvi Mishra, Yifei Ming, Han Yu, Rujun Han, Chen-Yu Lee, Tomas Pfister (Google)

title.zh: SEABench：自我进化的 agent 更能干了，但在之后的任务里悄悄变得不安全
title.en: SEABench: Self-Evolving Agents Get More Capable but Quietly Become Unsafe on Later Tasks

why.zh: 即使没有任何攻击者，agent 为了把眼前任务做得更完整、更高效而写进控制规则、记忆或工具里的改动，也会在之后语境不同的任务中造成泄露隐私、跳过确认或编造事实，因为这些局部有用的规则被当成“以后都这样做”而丢掉了原本的适用边界。
why.en: Even with no attacker, edits an agent writes into its controller rules, memory or tools to finish the current task more completely or efficiently later cause privacy leaks, skipped confirmations or made-up facts in tasks with a different context, because locally useful rules get promoted to always-apply defaults and lose the boundaries of where they belonged.

what.zh: 自改 harness 的 agent 可以在部署后持续改进，但以往安全研究主要看恶意注入或投毒，缺少能把后续安全失败因果归到良性自我更新上的基准。
what.en: Agents that rewrite their own harness keep improving after deployment, but prior safety work mostly studies malicious injection or poisoning and lacks a benchmark that causally ties later safety failures to benign self-updates.

how.zh: SEABench（弗吉尼亚大学、ELLIS 图宾根）在含 89 个个人数据文件的个人助理沙盒里构建 48 条纵向任务序列（3 种进化面 × 4 个领域 × 4 类危害，共 480 个任务），用 TextGrad 式压力测试寻找轨迹，并与不进化的配对 agent 对比归因：在找到的轨迹中进化后任务完成率从 35.7% 升到 47.2%，但安全失败率达 43.9%（316/720），而配对的不进化 agent 为 0，其中工具/技能面最脆弱（55.8%），Kimi K2.5 最高（60.8%）、GPT 5.6 Luna 最低（30.0%）。基于思维链的监控器能拦下 79 个有害输出中的 56 个（误报率 9.7%），但对工具/技能面只有 54.8%，因为缺陷藏在被调用的工具里而不在推理文本中；作者也提醒这些轨迹是压力测试搜出来的，不代表所有运行。
how.en: SEABench (University of Virginia and ELLIS Tübingen) builds 48 longitudinal task sequences (3 evolution surfaces × 4 domains × 4 harm types, 480 tasks) in a personal-assistant sandbox with 89 personal-data files, uses a TextGrad-style stress test to find trajectories and attributes failures against paired non-evolving agents, and in the discovered trajectories evolution raises task completion from 35.7% to 47.2% while safety failures hit 43.9% (316/720) against 0 for the paired non-evolving agents, with tools/skills the most fragile surface (55.8%), Kimi K2.5 the worst model (60.8%) and GPT 5.6 Luna the lowest (30.0%). A chain-of-thought monitor blocks 56 of 79 harmful outputs at a 9.7% false-positive rate but only 54.8% on the tools/skills surface, because the defect lives inside the invoked tool rather than the reasoning text, and the authors note the trajectories were found by stress testing and are not representative of all runs.

metric.en: Completion 35.7%→47.2% · safety failures 0→43.9%

items.authors: Saswat Das, Parvati Viswanathan, Daniel Donnelly, Chang Huang, Sahar Abdelnabi, Ferdinando Fioretto (University of Virginia, ELLIS Institute Tübingen, MPI-IS)

title.zh: SkillCompiler：把技能里规则明确的步骤编译成程序，自进化技能更稳更准
title.en: SkillCompiler: Compiling Well-Specified Skill Steps into Programs Makes Self-Evolving Skills Steadier and More Accurate

why.zh: 把自进化技能中输入明确、可检查的步骤编译成经过验证的程序，只把依赖语境的判断留给 LLM，能同时提高成绩并减少同一任务重复运行时的结果波动，因为程序每次按同样的流程执行，而文字技能每次都要重新被模型解读和生成。
why.en: Compiling the steps of a self-evolving skill that have explicit inputs and checkable outputs into validated programs, while leaving context-dependent judgment to the LLM, raises scores and cuts run-to-run outcome swings on the same task, because a program follows the same procedure every time while a text skill has to be reinterpreted and regenerated by the model on each run.

what.zh: 现有自进化技能（如 Trace2Skill、SkillOpt、GEPA）多以文字文档保存，即使技能不变，重复执行也会走不同推理路径、得到不同结果，而且已发现的可执行能力没有跨技能积累。
what.en: Existing self-evolving skills such as Trace2Skill, SkillOpt and GEPA are mostly stored as text documents, so even an unchanged skill can take different reasoning paths and get different outcomes on repeated runs, and executable pieces found along the way are not accumulated across skills.

how.zh: SkillCompiler（华东师范大学）把技能拆成细粒度操作、判断哪些可程序化，生成并验证程序后存入可跨技能检索复用的程序资产库，再根据失败轨迹修订技能骨架，在 5 个基准和 6 个模型家族上平均分比各模型最强基线高 6.02–11.90 分，ALFWorld（DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash）成功率从无技能的 79.60% 升到 98.26%（最强基线 EmbodiSkill 93.53%），LiveMath（Gemini-3.8-Flash）EM 比 SkillOpt 高 14 分、结果不稳定率从 32% 降到 11%。消融中去掉程序生成器让 ALFWorld 成功率跌到 53.48%、token 用量变为 7.36 倍，作者也指出在 SearchQA、DocVQA 这类依赖语境理解的任务上提升很小。
how.en: SkillCompiler (East China Normal University) splits skills into fine-grained operations, decides which can be programmed, synthesizes and validates programs into a program asset bank that other skills can retrieve and reuse, and revises the skill skeleton from failed traces, beating the strongest baseline for each of 6 model families by 6.02–11.90 points on average across 5 benchmarks, lifting ALFWorld success with DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash from 79.60% with no skill to 98.26% (best baseline EmbodiSkill 93.53%), and on LiveMath with Gemini-3.8-Flash beating SkillOpt by 14 EM points while cutting the outcome instability rate from 32% to 11%. Removing the programmer in ablation drops ALFWorld success to 53.48% with 7.36 times the tokens, and the authors note gains are small on context-heavy tasks such as SearchQA and DocVQA.

metric.zh: ALFWorld 98.26% · 不稳定率 32%→11% · 5 基准 × 6 模型
metric.en: ALFWorld 98.26% · instability 32%→11% · 5 benchmarks × 6 models

items.authors: Chengyu Yang, Yunxiang Zheng, Zongzheng Li, Jiamei Li, Boxun Lan, Xiaoyu Liu, Xiaoyu Zhang, Xiaohong Chen, Ming Hu (East China Normal University, China University of Geosciences)

title.zh: ClaimNov：AI 科学家的新颖性检查常把后来被人发表的好点子拒掉
title.en: ClaimNov: AI Scientists' Novelty Checks Often Reject Ideas Humans Later Publish

why.zh: AI 科学家流程里的新颖性检查越能拒掉旧点子，往往也越会误拒后来被人类发表的新点子，而把提案拆成几条具体贡献、逐条对照已有论文再下结论，就能既抓住抄袭又保留新点子，因为大多数好研究本来就只有部分贡献是新的。
why.en: Novelty checks in AI-scientist pipelines that reject the most already-done ideas also tend to wrongly reject the most ideas humans later publish, while splitting a proposal into a few concrete claims and checking each against prior papers catches copies and keeps new ideas, because most good research is only new in some of its contributions.

what.zh: AI 科学家流程用新颖性检查决定哪些生成的点子能获得算力，但这些检查只对整份提案给出通过或不通过，既难核实是否找对了已有工作，也会误杀渐进式创新。
what.en: AI-scientist pipelines use a novelty check to decide which generated ideas get compute, but these checks pass or fail a whole proposal, which makes it hard to verify they found the right prior work and kills incremental advances.

how.zh: 作者（UIUC）用 2026 年 3 月之后的论文构建 1,060 个带时间真值的提案来审计 7 种现有检查：Si et al 的检查抓住了全部 380 个改写伪装的已发表论文，却也拒掉了 96% 后来被发表的点子，ResearchAgent 拒掉 98.5%，AI Scientist v1 拒掉 51.8%。ClaimNov 抽取 2–4 条带类型的贡献，按维度检索已有论文的同类贡献并打 1–5 级覆盖分，再把整份逐条档案交给判定模型，抓住 97%（367/380）的伪装论文、只误拒 1.5%，去掉逐条档案误报会升到 11.8%，在 100 个掺入一条旧贡献的新提案中保留 91 个（最强现有检查 76 个）；局限是只覆盖英文 AI 研究，且伪装与判定用的是同一模型。
how.en: The authors (UIUC) build 1,060 proposals with temporal ground truth from papers after March 2026 to audit 7 existing checks, finding that Si et al's check catches all 380 reworded copies of published papers but also rejects 96% of ideas that were later published, ResearchAgent rejects 98.5% and AI Scientist v1 rejects 51.8%. ClaimNov extracts 2–4 typed claims, retrieves same-dimension claims from prior papers, rates coverage on a 1–5 scale and hands the full claim profile to a verdict judge, catching 97% (367/380) of disguised papers with 1.5% false alarms (11.8% without the profile) and keeping 91 of 100 new proposals with one spliced prior contribution against 76 for the best existing check, with the limits that it covers only English AI research and the same model wrote the disguises and judged them.

metric.zh: 抓住 97% 伪装论文 · 误拒 1.5% · 现有检查误拒最高 98.5%
metric.en: Catches 97% of disguised papers · 1.5% false alarms · existing checks up to 98.5%

items.authors: Miri Liu, Xiayu Zhao, Encheng Xie, ChengXiang Zhai (University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign)

title.zh: FlashRSI：一行命令在同一套设置下比较 13 种 harness 自改进方法
title.en: FlashRSI: One Command to Compare 13 Harness Self-Improvement Methods Under One Setup

why.zh: 把 13 种 RSI 方法放进同一个框架、同样的 harness 和基准里比较后发现，大多数方法在训练任务和相近任务上都能涨分，但一迁移到远域任务就普遍掉分，而只改 skills 或 prompt 的轻量方法常常和改整个 harness 的方法一样好，因为在源任务上学到的多是贴合该任务的规则，而不是通用能力。
why.en: Putting 13 RSI methods into one framework with the same harnesses and benchmarks shows that most of them gain on their training tasks and near-domain tasks but generally lose points once moved to far out-of-domain tasks, while light methods that only edit skills or prompts often match methods that rewrite the whole harness, because what gets learned on the source task is mostly task-fitted rules rather than general ability.

what.zh: OPRO、GEPA、ACE、Meta-Harness、RRSI 等 harness 自改进方法各自用不同的仓库、harness 和基准报告结果，彼此几乎无法公平比较。
what.en: Harness self-improvement methods such as OPRO, GEPA, ACE, Meta-Harness and RRSI each report results with their own repositories, harnesses and benchmarks, so they are hard to compare fairly.

how.zh: FlashRSI（人大高瓴 NLPIR，Apache 2.0）把 harness 表示为带角色标签（prompt、skill、tool、runtime、config）的文件快照，算法只能读写声明的范围，候选总是以完整 harness 在 MiniAgent、Claude Code、Codex 或 Pi 中原生执行，并保存快照谱系、轨迹和用量；在 4 个源基准、5 个近域和 2 个远域迁移的 12 方法对比中，Google 的 RRSI 在 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上两个 harness 都到 76.67（+13.34 / +10.00 pp）、AppWorld 上 Claude Code 92.86（+27.98 pp），只改 skills 的 SkillOpt 和改 context playbook 的 ACE 在 Mini-Agent 的 AppWorld 上都到 91.67（+26.19 pp），而 HotpotQA→DeepSearchQA 远域迁移中 GEPA、ADAS、DarwinX 在 Mini-Agent 上都掉 18 pp，只有少数配置（如 Meta-Harness 配 Claude Code +2 pp）不降。这是工具包发布，目前只有 README、项目页和结果表，尚无论文；本文读了 README、项目页和 RRSI 作者的引用帖，未亲自运行。
how.en: FlashRSI (Renmin University NLPIR, Apache 2.0) represents a harness as a snapshot of role-tagged files (prompt, skill, tool, runtime, config), lets each algorithm read and edit only its declared scope, always runs the complete candidate natively in MiniAgent, Claude Code, Codex or Pi, and keeps snapshot lineage, trajectories and usage; across 4 source benchmarks, 5 near-domain and 2 far-OOD transfers for 12 methods, Google's RRSI reaches 76.67 on Terminal-Bench 2.0 with both harnesses (+13.34 / +10.00 pp) and 92.86 on AppWorld with Claude Code (+27.98 pp), skills-only SkillOpt and context-playbook ACE both hit 91.67 on Mini-Agent AppWorld (+26.19 pp), while on the HotpotQA to DeepSearchQA far transfer GEPA, ADAS and DarwinX each lose 18 pp on Mini-Agent and only a few setups (such as Meta-Harness on Claude Code, +2 pp) avoid a drop. This is a toolkit release with a README, project page and results table but no paper yet; I read the README, project page and the RRSI author's quote post and did not run it.

metric.zh: 13 种 RSI 方法 × 30 个基准 × 4 个原生 harness · 远域迁移普遍掉分
metric.en: 13 RSI methods × 30 benchmarks × 4 native harnesses · far-OOD transfer mostly drops

items.authors: Jiajie Jin, Yuze Li, Yuyang Hu, Guanting Dong, Xiaoxi Li, Xinyu Yang, Jiejun Tan, Zhicheng Dou, Yutao Zhu (Renmin University of China)

title.zh: Masked Erosion：自改进 harness 的验收门会悄悄删掉冗余的安全规则
title.en: Masked Erosion: Acceptance Gates in Self-Improving Harnesses Quietly Delete Redundant Safeguards

why.zh: 自己改写 harness 的智能体会一条条删掉相互重叠的安全规则而验收门毫无察觉，因为只要还剩一条规则挡住危害，删掉其他规则在当前模型下看不出任何伤害，于是门只按任务得分做决定，等换成更弱的模型时缺失的那层防护就变成真实危害。
why.en: An agent that rewrites its own harness will strip overlapping safety rules one by one without the acceptance gate noticing, because while one remaining rule still blocks the harm, deleting the others shows no measurable harm under the current model, so the gate decides on task score alone and the missing backup turns into real harm once a weaker model runs the harness.

what.zh: ADAS、GEPA、ACE 等自改进智能体只在新 harness 在一批任务上得分更高时才接受修改，但这种门只看当前模型下 harness 做了什么，看不到某条防护失效后它还能挡住什么。
what.en: Self-improving agents such as ADAS, GEPA and ACE keep an edit only if the new harness scores higher on a task batch, but such a gate sees what the harness does under the current model, not what it would still prevent if one safeguard failed.

how.zh: 作者在 AppWorld 凭据滥用和 OpsSim 破坏性清理两个环境中，对 4 条书面防护的全部 16 种子集测量危害，并在 10 种门规则下跑了 411 个改进循环：躲在另一条有效防护后面的删除只带来 0.016 的新增危害（无防护时 0.422），4 任务批次大约只有 6% 的决策能察觉，贪心门 6 个循环中 5 个最终失去全部保护，配对显著性检验门为 0/6，但显著性检验挡不住真能提分的删除，同等代价下 20 任务批次保住全部 6 个 harness，40 任务批次全部失守。在当前模型下仍安全的 harness 换到 Qwen3-30B 后凭据滥用率为 0.30（配对门 0.004），GEPA 三次运行逐字保留了所有安全规则，却有两个最终 harness 把笔记模板改成“用这些凭据登录”，在 Qwen3-30B 下 40 次中分别滥用 2 次和 5 次（原 harness 0/80）；冻结安全文本或只接受“任意再删一条仍受保护”的 margin-aware 门可以保住冗余，作者也说明只研究了两个环境、各一种危害，且多数循环是人为植入删除的压力测试。
how.en: Measuring harm for all 16 subsets of four written safeguards in AppWorld credential misuse and OpsSim destructive clean-up and running 411 improvement loops under ten gate rules, the authors find a deletion behind another working safeguard adds only 0.016 harm (0.422 when nothing is left), a 4-task batch would notice it in about 6% of decisions, greedy gates end unprotected in 5 of 6 loops versus 0 of 6 for a paired significance test, yet significance cannot stop deletions that truly raise task success, and at the same cost 20-task batches kept all six harnesses protected while 40-task batches lost all six. Harnesses still safe under the loop's model misuse credentials in 0.30 of runs under Qwen3-30B (0.004 for paired-gate finals), GEPA kept every safety rule verbatim yet two of its three finals rewrote the note template to log in with stored credentials and misused them in 2 and 5 of 40 runs under Qwen3-30B (original 0 of 80), and freezing safety text or a margin-aware gate that accepts only if every one-layer ablation stays protected preserves depth, though the study covers two environments with one harm each and most loops plant deletions as stress tests.

metric.zh: 贪心门 5/6 循环失去保护 · 换弱模型后滥用率 0.30 vs 0.004
metric.en: Greedy gate unprotected in 5/6 loops · misuse 0.30 vs 0.004 after model swap

pills.zh: 被掩盖删除的新增危害
贪心 vs 配对门失守

items.authors: Hau-Sing So, Daixian Liu, Weicai Long (University of Macau, Tsinghua University)

title.zh: LongChang（龙场）：在物理规律被改写的世界里，LLM 能否自己发现问题并找出新规律
title.en: LongChang: Can LLMs Notice Altered Physics, Ask Their Own Questions and Find the Law?

why.zh: 没有任务和提示时，12 个前沿模型中只有一个能在物理规律被改写的模拟世界里真正做出有实验支撑的发现，因为模型常常无视意外现象、照原计划继续测试，或者过早停止，即使给更多回合也不会多做实验。
why.en: Without a task or hints, only one of 12 frontier models makes any experimentally supported discovery in simulated worlds with altered physics, because models tend to ignore unexpected behaviour and continue their planned tests or stop early, and giving them more turns does not make them run more experiments.

what.zh: PhysGym、NewtonBench 等物理规律发现基准都直接布置任务，而真实科研往往始于注意到意外观察并自己提出研究问题。
what.en: Physical-law discovery benchmarks such as PhysGym and NewtonBench assign the task up front, whereas real science often starts by noticing an unexpected observation and posing one's own research question.

how.zh: LongChang 用 MuJoCo 生成 15 个场景（1 个正常对照、14 个各改一条规律，如更重的物体下落更慢、碰撞交换颜色），被测 LLM 可推、抛、抓物体并用 MJCF 自建仪器，独立的 LLM 智能体负责生成和审查场景、审查仪器并按真实规律和完整记录评判报告的正确性与实验支撑；GPT-6-Astra 发现率 16.7%（证据支撑率 97.6% 但规律正确率仅 19.0%），Claude-Opus-5、Gemini-3.7-Flash、Grok-4.7 等其余 11 个模型都是 0%，给出任务和线索后升到 28.6%，回合上限从 100 提到 500 反而 14.3%（模型约 40 回合就停），关掉造仪器后降到 4.8%。正常对照中 36.1% 的报告声称了不存在的规律或给出无支撑解释，而根据被纠正错误自动演化出的 3 个新场景发现率均为 0%；作者也指出这些规律有标准答案，推广到真正未解的科学问题仍需新的评估方法。
how.en: LongChang builds 15 MuJoCo scenes (one normal control and 14 that each alter one law, such as heavier objects falling slower or colours swapping on contact), lets the tested LLM push, throw and grasp objects and build its own instruments in MJCF, and uses separate LLM agents to generate and review scenes, vet apparatus and judge each report's correctness and experimental support against the true law and full record; GPT-6-Astra reaches a 16.7% discovery rate (97.6% evidence support but only 19.0% law correctness), the other 11 models including Claude-Opus-5, Gemini-3.7-Flash and Grok-4.7 score 0%, a task plus a clue lifts it to 28.6%, raising the turn cap from 100 to 500 gives 14.3% because the model stops after about 40 turns, and disabling construction drops it to 4.8%. In the normal control 36.1% of reports claim nonexistent laws or unsupported explanations, and three new scenes evolved automatically from corrected errors all score 0%, while the authors note that known ground-truth laws make evaluation easy and extending it to genuinely open questions needs new evaluation methods.

metric.zh: 12 个模型中仅 GPT-6-Astra 发现 16.7% · 其余 0%
metric.en: Only GPT-6-Astra discovers (16.7%) of 12 models · rest 0%

items.authors: Zhen Yang, Wen Wang, Xander Xu, Ying-Cong Chen (HKUST(GZ), Alibaba Group, ZJU, HKUST)

title.zh: SmoothScore：研究智能体把相互矛盾的证据“抹平”成过度确定的结论
title.en: SmoothScore: Research Agents Smooth Conflicting Evidence into Overconfident Conclusions

why.zh: 深度研究智能体写出的报告读起来自信又引用充分，但结论常比引文能支撑的更绝对，主要原因之一是它们几乎不打开自己引用的文档、只看搜索摘要，而同时把全文放进上下文并加上校准指令，就能把明显被抹平的结论砍掉一半以上。
why.en: Deep-research agents write reports that read as confident and well cited yet state conclusions more decisively than their citations support, largely because they barely open the documents they cite and work from search snippets, and giving them the full text plus calibration instructions together removes more than half of the materially smoothed claims.

what.zh: autoresearch 和深度研究系统要把大量可能相互冲突的来源综合成一份报告，但现有评估主要查事实与引用是否正确，而不查结论是否夸大了证据的强度和适用范围。
what.en: Autoresearch and deep-research systems must synthesize many possibly conflicting sources into one report, but existing evaluations mainly check factual and citation correctness, not whether conclusions overstate the strength and scope of the evidence.

how.zh: SmoothScore 从报告中抽取核心结论，由支持方和怀疑方两个智能体在引用文档中找证据、按高层面向聚类，再由 GPT-5 评审打 1–5 分；在 7 个系统、4 个数据集上，每种设置都至少有 22% 的结论被明显抹平（≥3 分），GPT-5.6 Luna/Sol 均值约 1.7–1.95 最好，Gemini Deep Research 3.05–3.27 且 22–35% 的结论被严重抹平（≥4 分），开源的 DR Tulu 和 QUEST 也较高。轨迹显示 Luna 只打开了 19% 的引用页面、Sonnet 5 仅 2%，只给全文或只加指令效果都有限，两者结合后 Luna 被明显抹平的结论占比从 29% 降到 12%、Sonnet 5 从 61% 降到 25%；评分管线本身依赖 LLM，作者做了人工验证。
how.en: SmoothScore extracts a report's main conclusions, has a supporting agent and a skeptic agent gather evidence from the cited documents, clusters it into high-level aspects, and has a GPT-5 judge score each claim from 1 to 5; across 7 systems and 4 datasets at least 22% of claims in every setting are materially smoothed (score of 3 or more), GPT-5.6 Luna and Sol do best at a mean of about 1.7 to 1.95, Gemini Deep Research sits at 3.05 to 3.27 with 22–35% of claims severely smoothed (4 or more), and open-source DR Tulu and QUEST are also high. Traces show Luna opened only 19% of the pages it cited and Sonnet 5 only 2%, full documents alone or instructions alone help little, but together they cut materially smoothed claims from 29% to 12% for Luna and from 61% to 25% for Sonnet 5, though the scoring pipeline itself relies on LLMs, which the authors check with human validation.

metric.zh: 每种设置 ≥22% 结论被抹平 · 全文+指令后减半以上
metric.en: ≥22% of claims smoothed in every setting · full text + instructions halves it

items.authors: Tiasa Singha Roy, Manya Wadhwa, Greg Durrett (New York University)

title.zh: Scaling Discovery Requires Forgetting：定期清空会话与搜索历史，autoresearch 才能越过平台期
title.en: Scaling Discovery Requires Forgetting: Periodically Wiping Sessions and Search History Lets Autoresearch Break Its Plateau

why.zh: 让一组 autoresearch 智能体定期“遗忘”——丢掉所有会话和候选历史、只从当前最优解重新开始——在同样预算下比单智能体或并行智能体走得更远，因为长会话会让智能体锚定在自己过去的尝试上，改动越来越小、甚至宣布已到极限而停止提出新方案。
why.en: Making a team of autoresearch agents periodically forget, discarding every session and the candidate history and restarting from the best solution so far, gets further on the same budget than one agent or parallel agents, because long sessions anchor agents to their own past attempts until they make ever-smaller edits or declare a false limit and stop proposing.

what.zh: 把 autoresearch 做大有三种方式：让单个智能体跑更久、并行多个智能体、再让它们互相交流，但三种方式在固定预算下都会提前进入平台期。
what.en: Autoresearch can be scaled by running one agent longer, running several in parallel, or letting them share candidates, yet all three plateau well before a fixed budget runs out.

how.zh: 4 个可通信的智能体组成团队，每隔一段时间整体清空会话与文件系统中的候选记录，只保留最优候选并由新会话接着做；在 AtCoder AHC014、Frontier-CS、Anthropic VLIW kernel 和 nanochat-autoresearch 四个任务上该配置全部第一，平均比并行智能体高 10%、比单智能体高 22%（最多 15% / 39%）。轨迹分析显示随着会话变长，每次改动从约 150 行降到 30 行、推理 token 从约 28k 降到 7k；VLIW 上单智能体 763 个回合中有 532 个没有产出候选、耗掉 66.2% 花费，一个智能体在 1,710 cycles 时写下“已达到这台机器配置的实际极限”，而带遗忘的团队做到了 1,077；作者也承认会话和历史是一起清空的，无法区分哪一个更关键。
how.en: Four communicating agents periodically wipe their sessions and the filesystem's candidate records, keep only the best candidate, and continue from it in fresh sessions; on AtCoder AHC014, Frontier-CS, Anthropic's VLIW kernel and nanochat-autoresearch this setup is best on every task, on average 10% above parallel agents and 22% above a single agent (up to 15% and 39%). Trajectories show edits shrinking from about 150 lines to 30 and reasoning from about 28k to 7k tokens as sessions grow, and on VLIW 532 of a single agent's 763 turns produced no candidate while consuming 66.2% of spend, with one agent writing that it had reached the practical limit at 1,710 cycles while the forgetting team reached 1,077; sessions and history are wiped together, so which matters more is not separated.

metric.zh: 对比并行智能体平均 +10%（最多 +15%）· 对比单智能体最多 +39%
metric.en: +10% vs parallel agents on average (up to +15%) · up to +39% vs a single agent

items.authors: Shangyin Tan, Ben Zhou, Lakshya A Agrawal, … Koushik Sen, Alex Dimakis, Matei Zaharia (UC Berkeley, Stanford, Bespoke Labs)

title.zh: Coral Discovery：用“方向看板”给自主研究智能体分工，避免所有人都去改排行榜第一
title.en: Coral Discovery: A Direction Board That Divides Cognitive Labour Among Autonomous Research Agents Instead of Everyone Chasing the Leader

why.zh: 给多智能体自主研究加一块按“方向”记账的看板、并按方向自身的最好成绩发放功劳，能找到更好的解，因为只共享分数排行榜时智能体会一窝蜂地修改领先者，而最终胜出的方案往往来自基线从未进入的方向。
why.en: Giving a multi-agent autonomous-research team a board that tracks progress per direction and credits each direction against its own best finds better solutions, because with only a shared score leaderboard agents pile onto the leader, and the winning solutions mostly came from directions the baseline never entered.

what.zh: 多个 LLM 智能体在确定性评分器上改进程序时，共享内存通常只是一个按分数排序的排行榜，结果四个智能体里常有三个长期挤在同一方向上，探索与利用无从权衡。
what.en: When several LLM agents improve programs against a deterministic grader, their shared memory is usually a score-sorted leaderboard, so three of four agents often crowd into one direction for most of a run and nobody weighs exploration against exploitation.

how.zh: 一个独立的 verifier 会话读每次提交的 diff，把它归入一个“方向”（得分机制）和一个“方法”（本次改动），看板为每个方向计算收益率（每次评测换来的提升）、加探索奖励的潜力值、开新方向的期权价值 NEW 以及建议人数，功劳只在刷新本方向最好成绩时发放，智能体先做完自己的线再把看板当建议；在与 MIT CORAL 相同的 9 个任务上（Claude Opus 4.6、4 个智能体、无联网、不读评分器），对复现的 MIT CORAL 胜 6 平 1 负 2；Kernel 从 MIT CORAL 公布的 1103 cycles 降到 1095，并在第 275 次评测就越过 1103（原来用了 596 次），Polyominoes 以 91.78 刷新 SOTA（原 87.0）；它共开了 68 个方向（基线 41 个），但在 LLM-SQL 和 Txn Sched. 上分散预算没有回本。
how.en: An independent verifier session reads each diff and files it under a direction (the mechanism earning the score) and a method (this change); the board computes each direction's yield per eval, an exploration-bonus potential, the option value of opening a NEW direction and a suggested head count, credit is earned only by beating the direction's own best, and agents finish their line before taking the board as advice. On the nine MIT CORAL tasks (Claude Opus 4.6, four agents, no internet, no grader access) it beats the reproduced MIT CORAL on 6, ties 1 and loses 2, cuts Kernel from MIT CORAL's published 1103 cycles to 1095 and passes 1103 at eval 275 instead of 596, and sets a Polyominoes SOTA of 91.78 against 87.0, opening 68 directions to the baseline's 41, though spreading the budget did not pay off on LLM-SQL and Txn Sched.

metric.zh: 对复现 MIT CORAL 胜 6/9 · Polyominoes 91.78（原 SOTA 87.0）
metric.en: Beats reproduced MIT CORAL on 6/9 · Polyominoes 91.78 (prior SOTA 87.0)

items.authors: Xinxing Ren, Qianbo Zang, Ziyan Wang, … Yali Du, Milind Tambe, Zekun Guo (Coral AI Labs, Trento, Harvard, Cambridge, KCL, Hull)

title.zh: HeurEvo：智能体同时演化算法结构、代码与可复用组件，2 分钟内的启发式赢过 Gurobi 48 小时解
title.en: HeurEvo: Agents Co-Evolve Algorithm Plans, Code and Reusable Components, and Two-Minute Heuristics Beat Gurobi's 48-Hour Solutions

why.zh: 让智能体同时演化“用哪些阶段、怎么分配时间”的计划、实现代码和共享组件库，比只演化固定流程里的单个启发式更好，因为在严格时限下，决定质量的往往是启发式与求解器如何组合、算力花在哪一步。
why.en: Letting agents evolve the plan (which stages to use and how to split runtime), the code and a shared component library together beats evolving single heuristics inside a fixed procedure, because under tight time limits quality is decided by how heuristics and solvers are combined and where compute is spent.

what.zh: 现有的智能体启发式设计（OpenEvolve、AdaEvolve、EvoX 等）通常只在预设流程内改进启发式组件或单独调求解器参数，无法整体调整算法结构与求解器的用法。
what.en: Existing agentic heuristic design (OpenEvolve, AdaEvolve, EvoX and others) usually improves heuristic components inside a predefined procedure or tunes solver settings in isolation, so the overall algorithm structure and solver use never adapt together.

how.zh: Planner 决定用哪些组件、如何组合和分配运行时间，Coder 把计划写成可执行代码，Component evolver 更新共享组件库，Interpreter 智能体读执行结果指出改进点，在岛屿式进化框架里离线演化，测试时每个实例只给 120 秒。11 个合成问题上平均测试 gap 为 −1.45%（基线均为正），在 7/11 类上超过 Gurobi 48 小时的解（训练集 8/11）；消融中固定计划只演化代码的测试 gap 为 +0.25%；6 个 MIPLIB 问题中 4 个优于 AdaEvolve，非线性问题先 HeurEvo 后 AdaEvolve 精修，在 5 个配置上数值上优于已报告最好值（作者提醒参考值有舍入）。
how.en: A planner picks components, their order and runtime split, a coder writes the plan as code, a component evolver updates the shared library and an interpreter agent reads execution traces to point at improvements, all evolved offline in an island-based framework with 120 seconds per test instance. On 11 synthetic problems the mean test gap is −1.45% while every baseline is positive, beating Gurobi's 48-hour solutions on 7 of 11 classes (8 of 11 in training), with fixed-plan code evolution at +0.25% in ablation; it wins 4 of 6 MIPLIB problems against AdaEvolve, and HeurEvo followed by AdaEvolve refinement is numerically better than reported best values in 5 nonlinear configurations, which the authors caution are compared against rounded references.

metric.zh: 合成问题平均测试 gap −1.45% · 7/11 超过 Gurobi 48 小时解
metric.en: Mean synthetic test gap −1.45% · beats Gurobi 48-hour solutions on 7/11

items.authors: Feijie Wu, Hugo Barbalho, Konstantina Mellou, Marco Molinaro, Jing Gao, Ishai Menache, Xinzhi Zhang, Sirui Li (Purdue University, Microsoft Research)

title.zh: MolRSI：跨任务记忆让分子发现智能体递归改进自己的搜索策略，湿实验命中率几乎翻倍
title.en: MolRSI: Cross-Task Memory Lets a Molecular-Discovery Agent Recursively Improve Its Own Search Policy, Nearly Doubling the Wet-Lab Hit Rate

why.zh: 把以往任务中哪些工作流得分高、哪些修改有效、哪些执行出错写进持久记忆，再用来引导新任务的工作流搜索，能让分子发现智能体做出比专家流程更好的筛选方案，因为它改进的不只是单个工作流，而是“如何开发工作流”的搜索策略本身。
why.en: Writing which workflows scored well, which modifications worked and which runs failed into persistent memory, and using it to steer workflow search on new tasks, lets a molecular-discovery agent build screening pipelines that beat an expert pipeline, because it improves not just one workflow but the search policy for developing workflows.

what.zh: AI 智能体可以自动执行专家设计的分子设计流程，但这并不能回答如何为新任务优化工作流，也不能让开发过程随经验变好。
what.en: AI agents can automate expert-defined molecular design protocols, but that does not say how to optimize workflows for a new task or make workflow development improve with experience.

how.zh: Explore Agent 先把相关论文、代码和工具整理成可执行 skills（抗菌任务共 110 个），再用基于经验的 MCTS 搜索工作流，选择分数综合当前和相关任务的表现，refinement 与 execution 记忆指导修改和排错，结果回写记忆用于后续任务。抗生素发现中借助 25 个源任务的经验，测试 107 个化合物得到 17 个对金黄色葡萄球菌 MIC ≤ 32 μg/mL 的命中，命中率 15.9%，而同训练数据、同筛选库的专家流程为 8.7%（21/241）；在 pMHC 结合蛋白设计中借助 14 个 minibinder 任务的经验，得到 8 个对 MART-1 与 SARS-CoV-1 pMHC 有偏好结合的命中，而 Claude Science 开发的流程没有命中。
how.en: An Explore Agent turns relevant papers, code and tools into executable skills (110 for the antibacterial tasks), then experience-guided MCTS searches over workflows, scoring selections by performance on the current and related tasks, with refinement and execution memory guiding edits and repairs and every outcome written back for later tasks. Drawing on 25 source tasks for antibiotic discovery, 17 of 107 tested compounds hit Staphylococcus aureus at MIC ≤ 32 μg/mL, a 15.9% hit rate against 8.7% (21 of 241) for the prior expert workflow on the same training data and library, and drawing on 14 minibinder tasks for pMHC binder design it produced 8 hits with preferential binding to MART-1 and SARS-CoV-1 pMHCs, while the Claude Science workflow produced none.

metric.zh: 湿实验命中率 15.9% vs 专家流程 8.7% · pMHC 8 个命中 vs Claude Science 0
metric.en: Wet-lab hit rate 15.9% vs 8.7% expert workflow · 8 pMHC hits vs 0 for Claude Science

items.authors: Yikun Zhang, Xiwei Cheng, Mingze Yuan, … Nir Hacohen, James J. Collins, Wengong Jin (Northeastern, Broad Institute, Harvard, MIT and others)

title.zh: Appreciation Teaches Unauthorized Execution：自演化让个人智能体更容易被间接提示注入劫持
title.en: Appreciation Teaches Unauthorized Execution: Self-Evolution Makes Personal Agents Easier to Hijack by Indirect Prompt Injection

why.zh: 个人智能体从用户好评中自我进化（写 skills 或 RL）后，更容易执行外部内容里藏着的陌生人指令，因为它学会了“执行文件里的任务”这个习惯，却丢掉了“前提是用户授权过”这个条件（作者称为 authorization conflation）。
why.en: Once personal agents self-evolve from user praise, through written skills or RL, they become much more likely to obey a stranger's instruction hidden in external content, because they learn the habit of executing tasks found in files and drop the condition that the user authorized it, which the authors call authorization conflation.

what.zh: OpenClaw 这类个人智能体会在部署后从用户反馈中学习，但没人检查这种自演化是否会削弱它们对间接提示注入（IPI）的抵抗力。
what.en: Personal agents such as OpenClaw now learn from user feedback after deployment, but nobody had checked whether that self-evolution weakens their resistance to indirect prompt injection (IPI).

how.zh: 两阶段实验：适应阶段用户让智能体读外部内容并完成其中的任务并给好评，智能体通过 MetaClaw（skills）或 OpenClaw-RL（RL）进化；测试阶段第三方把相似任务写进新内容，但用户只要求摘要，由确定性状态检查判定攻击是否成功；与不进化的基础智能体相比，平均攻击成功率在 skill 进化下上升 14.0–48.8 个百分点、RL 下上升 3.0–39.3 个百分点，仅 12 次适应对话就让 GPT-OSS-120B 从 4.7% 升到 53.5%；进化出的 skill 甚至写着“每条指令恰好执行一次”，27 条有害指令在 162 次对话中被执行 119 次（空 skill 库为 1 次）。在适应中奖励“不执行未请求的任务”可把 ASR 从 35.0% 降到 5.8%，而给工具输出加分隔符只能减半。
how.en: In an adaptation phase the user asks the agent to read external content, do the task in it and praises success, and the agent evolves through MetaClaw (skills) or OpenClaw-RL (RL); in the test phase a third party plants a similar task in new content while the user asks only for a summary, and deterministic state checks score the attack. Against the non-evolving base agent, mean attack success rises 14.0–48.8 points under skill evolution and 3.0–39.3 under RL, with 12 adaptation chats taking GPT-OSS-120B from 4.7% to 53.5%, one evolved skill saying to execute each instruction exactly once, and 27 harmful instructions executed in 119 of 162 conversations versus 1 of 162 with an empty library; praising the agent for leaving an unrequested task alone cuts ASR from 35.0% to 5.8%, while delimiting tool outputs only halves it.

metric.zh: ASR 上升：skill 进化 +14.0–48.8 pp · RL +3.0–39.3 pp
metric.en: ASR rise: +14.0–48.8 pp under skill evolution · +3.0–39.3 pp under RL

items.authors: Xinyan Wang, Xiaogeng Liu, Jun Shao, Chaowei Xiao (University of Wisconsin–Madison, Johns Hopkins University)

title.zh: GEPA-Curator：先挑选该从哪些失败中学习，再做反思式 prompt / harness 优化
title.en: GEPA-Curator: Choosing Which Failures to Learn From Before Reflective Prompt and Harness Optimization

why.zh: 让一个 Curator 智能体先剔除“不可能完成”或评测不稳定的任务、并给 Reflector 配上同一任务过去的成功轨迹，能让 GEPA 式自改进稳定变好，因为很多失败源于 harness 缺工具、环境故障或评审噪声，直接从中反思会写出过度泛化、反而伤害可解任务的规则。
why.en: Having a Curator agent drop impossible or flaky tasks and hand the Reflector a past success on the same task makes GEPA-style self-improvement reliably better, because many failures come from missing harness tools, broken environments or noisy judges, and reflecting on them writes over-general rules that hurt solvable tasks.

what.zh: GEPA、ACE 这类反思式优化器默认每个失败都是 prompt 的问题，但智能体任务中的失败常常来自 harness 限制、执行随机性或 LLM 评审噪声，验证集门控也挡不住这些坏信号。
what.en: Reflective optimizers such as GEPA and ACE treat every failed rollout as a prompt problem, yet agentic failures often come from harness limits, stochastic execution or noisy LLM judges, and validation gating does not filter that bad signal out.

how.zh: Curator 读取每个任务的历史轨迹，决定本轮 minibatch 跑哪些任务（暂时跳过稳定成功、harness 导致的重复失败和评审不一致的任务），并在同一次调用中挑选一条可信的过往成功轨迹作为对照；以 gpt-oss-120b 为执行者，在 GoBrowse/WebArena 四个站点上平均成功率从 GEPA 的 78.7% 提到 82.1%（Gemini 3.1 Pro 优化）和 79.5%→84.5%（Claude Opus 5），AppWorld Test-N 用 Opus 时 52.9%→68.8%，论文中一个例子显示两条不可能任务让 GEPA 学到“到处搜索”，minibatch 分 8→9 被接受，却让一个原本 5 步解决的任务 30 步也没完成。扩展到 Meta-Harness 代码搜索后（Meta-Harness-Curator），Math-RAG 准确率 45.33→46.33、文本分类 48.06→51.04，收益不大；高效版成本约为 GEPA 的 1.31 倍，非 WebArena 基准上 173.98 美元，比 ACE 便宜 4.42 倍。
how.en: The Curator reads each task's history and decides which tasks enter the next minibatch (temporarily skipping stable successes, harness-caused repeat failures and inconsistently judged tasks), and in the same call picks one trusted past success as a contrastive reference; with gpt-oss-120b acting, mean success on the four GoBrowse/WebArena sites rises from GEPA's 78.7% to 82.1% (Gemini 3.1 Pro optimizer) and from 79.5% to 84.5% (Claude Opus 5), AppWorld Test-N with Opus goes from 52.9% to 68.8%, and one traced case shows two impossible tasks teaching GEPA to search everywhere, lifting the minibatch score from 8 to 9 so the edit was kept while a task once solved in 5 steps then failed after 30. Applied to Meta-Harness code search (Meta-Harness-Curator) the gains are modest, Math-RAG accuracy 45.33 to 46.33 and text classification 48.06 to 51.04, and the efficient variant costs about 1.31× GEPA and $173.98 on the non-WebArena benchmarks, 4.42× cheaper than ACE.

metric.zh: WebArena 均值 82.1% vs GEPA 78.7%（Gemini）· 84.5% vs 79.5%（Opus）
metric.en: WebArena mean 82.1% vs GEPA 78.7% (Gemini) · 84.5% vs 79.5% (Opus)

items.authors: Zack Yu, Nicholas Lee, Minjae Lee, Lakshya A Agrawal, Matei Zaharia, Michael W. Mahoney, Kurt Keutzer, Sehoon Kim, Amir Gholami et al. (UC Berkeley, ICSI, LBNL, Furiosa AI, KAIST)

title.zh: rTaste：研究智能体有“品味”吗？把 415 个提议实验全部跑一遍来检验
title.en: rTaste: Do Research Agents Have Taste? Running All 415 Proposed Experiments to Find Out

why.zh: 前沿模型做研究智能体时能提出不少可靠又有价值的小实验，但它们的排序和预测几乎没有帮上忙，因为它们先写、也优先选的往往是最显而易见、最可能“通过”的后续实验，而真正超出原论文的方向很少。
why.en: Frontier models acting as research agents propose plenty of sound and valuable small experiments, but their rankings and forecasts add little, because they write first and rank first the most obvious follow-ups that are likely to pass, while experiments that genuinely go beyond the paper are rare.

what.zh: autoresearch 能执行实验，但还没被托付最关键的“品味”判断：在结果出来之前决定哪些实验值得做。
what.en: Autoresearch agents can execute experiments, but they have not been trusted with taste, the judgment of which experiments are worth running before the outcome is known.

how.zh: 六个前沿模型（单人或团队）各读一篇 2026 年 8–9 月的新 NLP 论文，提出 5 个最小可行实验（MVE）、预注册阈值、预测是否通过并排序，再由独立执行者把全部 MVE（包括排最后的）都实现，三个模型审稿人评判；415 个 MVE 中 194 个被判为合理、有价值且新，但其中只有 73 个超出原论文且不显而易见。智能体首选是审稿人最看重实验的比例为 38%（随机 20%），但并不优于“第一个写下的实验”（首选有 47% 就是第一个写的），预测的 Brier 分 0.192 优于基线 0.240，却不比只读原论文和 5 条注册内容的同模型裁判更准（差 0.006）；团队每个条件花费 23.93 美元、单人 15.31 美元，但提案质量没有显著提升，且全部标签来自模型、每种条件只跑一次。
how.en: Six frontier models, alone or as teams, each read a new NLP paper from August–September 2026, propose five minimum viable experiments (MVEs) with pre-registered thresholds, forecast whether each passes and rank them, after which a separate executor implements every MVE (including the last-ranked) and three model auditors judge the results; of 415 MVEs, 194 are judged sound, valuable and new, but only 73 of those also go beyond the seed paper and are non-obvious. The agent's first choice is the auditors' most valued MVE 38% of the time against 20% for a random pick, yet it is not shown to beat the MVE written first (which it picks 47% of the time), its forecasts reach a Brier score of 0.192 against a 0.240 base rate but are no better than a same-model judge that saw only the seed paper and the five registrations (a 0.006 difference), and teams cost $23.93 per condition against $15.31 for a single researcher without a significant quality gain, with all labels model-made and each condition run once.

metric.zh: 415 个 MVE → 194 个合格 → 仅 73 个超出原论文
metric.en: 415 MVEs → 194 sound/valuable/new → only 73 beyond the paper

items.authors: Art Kanke (University of Minnesota)

title.zh: A-RSI：根据训练日志判断何时换题的零数据多模态自改进
title.en: A-RSI: Training Logs Decide When to Refresh Tasks in Zero-Data Multimodal Self-Improvement

why.zh: 零数据自改进循环最先卡在“题用完了”，只看训练日志里还在产生学习信号的题目数来决定何时整池换新、再随机抽取答案由程序计算的新题，就能持续提分，而且精心挑难度的选题规则并不比随机更好。
why.en: A zero-data self-improvement loop stalls first when its tasks run dry, and refreshing the whole pool only when training logs show fewer prompts still giving learning signal, then drawing random new tasks with program-computed answers, keeps scores rising, while carefully difficulty-targeted selection does no better than random.

what.zh: 递归自改进方法多关注下一步生成什么经验，却很少问何时该换上新经验，而且常用自洽或多数投票造标签，让模型自己的错误变成下一轮的监督。
what.en: Recursive self-improvement methods mostly ask what experience to generate next rather than when fresh experience is needed, and they often build labels by self-consistency or majority vote, so the model's own errors become the next round's supervision.

how.zh: 一个固定的模型编写程序库生成几何、图表、表格、计数等多模态题并计算参考答案，Solver 用 GRPO 训练（每窗口 100 次更新），控制器只读训练日志中组内奖励有差异的 prompt 数和训练准确率，判断池子饱和后整池替换为 400 道未用过的随机题，不看验证或测试分；Qwen3-VL-8B 在 11 个基准上的均值从 57.77 升到 61.05，只用 800 道新题，而每窗口都换题要 3,200 道题才到 60.64，在第六窗口对比中为 60.40 vs 继续用旧池的 58.35。作者也指出部分零数据增益只是学会在输出长度限制内答完（包括已发布的 MM-Zero 权重），MiMo-VL-7B 仅从 59.08 到 60.71，且每个配置只训练一次。
how.en: A fixed library of model-written programs generates multimodal geometry, chart, table and counting tasks with computed reference answers, the Solver trains with GRPO in windows of 100 updates, and a controller reads only training-log counts of prompts with within-group reward variation plus training accuracy, swapping in 400 unused random tasks when the pool saturates without consulting validation or test scores; Qwen3-VL-8B's eleven-benchmark average rises from 57.77 to 61.05 with only 800 fresh tasks, whereas refreshing every window needs 3,200 tasks to reach 60.64, and at the sixth window it scores 60.40 against 58.35 for continuing on the old pool. The authors note that part of any zero-data gain is just learning to finish within the output limit (including for released MM-Zero weights), MiMo-VL-7B moves only from 59.08 to 60.71, and each arm was trained once.

metric.en: Macro11 57.77→61.05 · only 800 fresh tasks

items.authors: Yu Liu, Youxing Li, Yuedong Tan, … Pei Fu, Radu Timofte, Nicu Sebe, Barnabas Poczos, Jian Luan (Xiaomi, SeerRay Lab et al.)

title.zh: Benchmarks Are Surprisingly Compaction-Friendly：上下文压缩几乎不影响长程基准分数，却会悄悄丢掉规则
title.en: Benchmarks Are Surprisingly Compaction-Friendly: Context Compaction Barely Moves Long-Horizon Scores but Silently Drops Rules

why.zh: 在 PaperBench、ProgramBench、PostTrainBench 这类自主长程基准上，上下文压缩（compaction）几乎不影响 1M 上下文模型的分数，因为目标只给一次、进度都在磁盘上可以重读，但只存在于上下文中的约束（如防作弊规则、用户的“别碰这里”）会被逐次丢掉。
why.en: On autonomous long-horizon benchmarks like PaperBench, ProgramBench and PostTrainBench, context compaction barely changes scores for 1M-context models because the goal is given once and progress lives on disk to be re-read, but constraints that exist only in the context, such as anti-cheating rules or a user's do-not-touch instructions, are lost compaction by compaction.

what.zh: 压缩是所有编程智能体 scaffold 的标配且天然有损，但此前从未在前沿模型和真实长程智能体任务上系统测过它会不会伤害任务表现或违反规则。
what.en: Compaction is standard in every coding-agent scaffold and lossy by design, yet it had never been tested systematically with frontier models on realistic long-horizon agent tasks to see whether it hurts performance or breaks rules.

how.zh: 固定 OpenCode scaffold，实现五种压缩策略，在三个长程基准上测试 Claude Opus 4.6、GPT-5.4、GPT-5.3-Codex、Gemini 3.1 Pro：160K–380K 的压缩阈值对 1M 上下文模型基本无影响，只有 400K 窗口的 GPT-5.3-Codex 在 PaperBench 上从 160K 的 0.38 到 260K 以上约 0.60；没有策略胜过默认自摘要，而去掉推理块或用小模型摘要会让部分模型掉最多 20 分（GPT-5.4 PaperBench 0.59→0.43）。ProgramBench 上第一次压缩平均就丢掉 3 条防作弊规则中的 0.92 条，第 10 次 1.93 条、第 30 次 2.65 条（GPT-5.3-Codex 每次丢 2.73 条，Opus 4.6 仅 0.51 条）；在 SWE-chat 真实会话的 269 条用户约束中整体保留 81%，但流程指令（35.9%）和范围排除（36.8%）的丢失率约为功能需求（6.2%）的 6 倍。
how.en: With the OpenCode scaffold fixed and five compaction strategies implemented, Claude Opus 4.6, GPT-5.4, GPT-5.3-Codex and Gemini 3.1 Pro are tested on three long-horizon benchmarks: compaction thresholds of 160K–380K barely matter for 1M-context models, and only 400K-window GPT-5.3-Codex moves on PaperBench, from 0.38 at 160K to about 0.60 at 260K and above; no strategy beats default self-summarization, while dropping reasoning blocks or summarizing with a smaller model costs some models up to 20 points (GPT-5.4 on PaperBench 0.59 to 0.43). On ProgramBench the first compaction already drops 0.92 of 3 anti-cheating rules on average, rising to 1.93 by the 10th and 2.65 by the 30th (GPT-5.3-Codex drops 2.73 per compaction, Opus 4.6 only 0.51), and across 269 user constraints in real SWE-chat sessions 81% survive overall but process instructions (35.9% dropped) and scope exclusions (36.8%) are lost about 6× as often as feature requirements (6.2%).

metric.zh: 阈值对 1M 模型无显著影响 · 首次压缩即丢 0.92/3 条规则
metric.en: Threshold no effect on 1M models · first compaction drops 0.92/3 rules

items.authors: Jeanne Salle, Hardik Bhatnagar, Matthias Bethge, Sahar Abdelnabi, Maksym Andriushchenko (ELLIS Institute Tübingen, MPI-IS, Tübingen AI Center)

title.zh: Context Is a Pipeline, Not a Window：agent harness 在模型读到之前就丢掉三分之一的工具输出
title.en: Context Is a Pipeline, Not a Window: Agent Harnesses Lose a Third of Tool Output Before the Model Reads It

why.zh: 智能体的上下文窗口几乎空着，却仍有三分之一的工具结果在送达模型前被截断，因为 harness 按固定字符数截 JSON、删掉的是靠后的字段而不是不重要的字段，而代价首先体现为多花的工具调用和算力，准确率和延迟面板都看不出来。
why.en: An agent's context window sat nearly empty while a third of tool results were still cut before reaching the model, because the harness sliced JSON at a fixed character count and so deleted late fields rather than unimportant ones, and the cost shows up first as extra tool calls and compute that accuracy and latency dashboards never reveal.

what.zh: 评价智能体通常只看上下文窗口大小和最终准确率，但没人测量工具输出在 harness 各环节（交付、执行、保留、交接）中丢了多少。
what.en: Agents are usually judged by context-window size and final accuracy, but nobody measures how much tool output is lost across the harness stages of delivery, action, retention and hand-off.

how.zh: 在一个读 Linux 内核 trace 定位注入故障的根因智能体中，720 次运行、11,189 个工具结果里有 3,827 个被前缀截断且全部变成坏 JSON，窗口最高只用到 5.75%，同一载荷里一个容器列表只有 4.7% 的调用能送达，相邻列表却有 99.3%，另有 51% 的 worker 正好停在步数上限。在 145 次受控实验中，截断后仍 15/15 找对元凶（修复后 14/15），但工具调用 53→68→76（最多多 43%）、计算量约翻倍、产出率 0.61→0.34→0.31；生产 trace 重放中截断让靠后列表的 128 条记录 0 条送达（元凶证据全在其中），作者调查的 7 个框架里 langchain-core 和 smolagents 也用同类不安全截断，但只测了一个 harness、一个领域、一个模型，因果性仍未定论。
how.en: In a root-cause agent that reads Linux kernel traces to find injected faults, 3,827 of 11,189 tool results across 720 runs were prefix-truncated and every one became broken JSON while the largest prompt used only 5.75% of the window, one container list reached the model in 4.7% of calls while its neighbour in the same payload got through 99.3%, and 51% of workers stopped exactly at their step limit. In 145 controlled runs the truncated agent still named the culprit 15/15 (repaired 14/15) but tool calls rose 53 to 68 to 76 (up to 43% more), computations roughly doubled and yield fell 0.61 to 0.34 to 0.31, a production-trace replay delivered 0 of 128 late-list records holding the culprit's evidence, and a survey of seven frameworks found langchain-core and smolagents cut output the same unsafe way, though the study covers one harness, one domain and one model and causality for accuracy is still open.

metric.zh: 3,827/11,189 工具结果被截断 · 窗口最高仅用 5.75%
metric.en: 3,827/11,189 tool results truncated · window peak only 5.75%

items.authors: Yuvraj Sehgal, Mahsa Panahandeh, Naser Ezzati-Jivan (Brock University, University of Ottawa)

title.zh: Evolving Agent Teams：会自我重组的智能体团队做 GPU kernel 优化
title.en: Evolving Agent Teams: Self-Restructuring Agent Teams for GPU Kernel Optimization

why.zh: 让主管智能体在每次停滞时诊断原因（知识缺口还是搜索已穷尽）并重组团队角色，比固定团队或单个编程智能体强得多，因为单个智能体在正确性失败后会放弃难但更快的设计，而固定团队的信息被割裂在不同角色之间。
why.en: Letting a supervisor diagnose each plateau (a knowledge gap or an exhausted search) and restructure the team's roles beats both fixed teams and single coding agents, because single agents abandon hard but faster designs after correctness failures and fixed teams split information across roles.

what.zh: 用编程智能体做 kernel 等性能优化时，单个智能体或固定分工的团队很快停滞，往往停在 WMMA/SIMT 这类容易写对但更慢的方案上。
what.en: Coding agents optimizing kernels and similar performance targets plateau quickly, whether alone or in fixed-role teams, and tend to settle on designs like WMMA or SIMT that are easier to get correct but slower.

how.zh: 主管在停滞时改写团队结构（例如加入 Knowledge Integrator 汇总分散的信息），团队共享一个持久文件系统保存学习文档、演化历史和产物，在 MLA decode 上共尝试了 100 多种团队配置。同等预算下达到 FlashInfer 的 0.74×（Claude Code 0.51×、固定 4 角色团队 0.31×、Codex GPT-5.5 xhigh 0.28×），延长预算后达到生产版 FlashInfer MLA decode 的 1.21×、47 个 workload 中 36 个更快（此前最好的 K-Search 为 0.61×），且生成的 kernel 用上了 WGMMA；另有 GDN prefill 4.06×、GEMM+AllReduce 1.56×（ThunderKittens 1.54×）等结果，但每个主设置只跑了两次，也没有成本 Pareto 分析。
how.en: The supervisor rewrites the team structure at each plateau (for example adding a Knowledge Integrator to pull scattered information together), and the team shares a persistent file system holding a learning doc, the evolution history and its artifacts, with over 100 team configurations tried on MLA decode. At matched budget it reaches 0.74× FlashInfer (Claude Code 0.51×, a fixed 4-role team 0.31×, Codex GPT-5.5 xhigh 0.28×), and with an extended budget it hits 1.21× production FlashInfer MLA decode and is faster on 36 of 47 workloads (previous best K-Search 0.61×) with kernels that use WGMMA; other results include 4.06× on GDN prefill and 1.56× on GEMM+AllReduce (ThunderKittens 1.54×), though each main setting ran only twice and there is no cost Pareto analysis.

metric.zh: MLA decode 1.21× FlashInfer · 36/47 workload 更快
metric.en: MLA decode 1.21× FlashInfer · faster on 36/47 workloads

items.authors: Shiyi Cao, Ziming Mao, Dacheng Li, Joseph E. Gonzalez, Ion Stoica et al. (UC Berkeley)

title.zh: 批量化 GEPA：并行提议让反思式 prompt 优化更快也更好
title.en: Batching the Reflective Optimization Loop: Parallel Proposals Make GEPA Faster and Better

why.zh: 每步同时提出并评估一批候选，而不是一次一个，能让 GEPA 快 3–4 倍且测试分更高，因为在同样的评估预算下针对验证集的自适应轮数更少，过拟合验证集也就更少。
why.en: Proposing and scoring a batch of candidates per step instead of one makes GEPA 3–4× faster and better on held-out tests, because at the same evaluation budget there are fewer adaptive rounds against the validation set and so less overfitting to it.

what.zh: GEPA 这类反思式 prompt 优化器是串行的：提出一个候选、评估、等待、再重复，动辄数小时，评估算力大多闲置。
what.en: Reflective prompt optimizers like GEPA run sequentially, proposing one candidate, evaluating it and waiting before the next, so runs take hours while evaluation capacity sits idle.

how.zh: 每步从 GEPA 的 Pareto 前沿采样 P 个父代、每个父代做 N 次反思式变异，并发评估全部 P·N 个子代再并行验证胜者，总 metric 调用预算与串行版相同（gpt-5-mini 为提议模型）。16 路并行下墙钟时间缩短约 3–4 倍，LiveBench-Math 测试分 68.9%→72.1%（2×2），HoVer 49.0%→60.0%（8×1），LiveBench-Math 上验证到测试的落差串行为 9 分、2×4 仅 2 分，2×4 约 4 美元内就达到最终验证分，已作为插件采样策略并入开源 gepa 包；仅在两个任务和一种预算上测试。
how.en: Each step samples P parents from GEPA's Pareto frontier, draws N reflective mutations per parent, scores all P·N children concurrently and validates the winners in parallel, under the same total metric-call budget as the sequential run (gpt-5-mini as proposer). At 16-way parallelism wall-clock time falls about 3–4×, LiveBench-Math test rises from 68.9% to 72.1% (2×2) and HoVer from 49.0% to 60.0% (8×1), the validation-to-test gap on LiveBench-Math is 9 points for sequential against 2 for 2×4, and 2×4 reaches its final validation score within about $4; it ships as a plug-in sampling strategy in the open-source gepa package, though it was tested on only two tasks and one budget each.

metric.en: ~3–4× faster wall-clock · HoVer 49.0→60.0%

items.authors: Jialin Zhang, Lakshya A Agrawal, Shangyin Tan, Donghyun Lee, Lutfi Eren Erdogan, Dan Klein, Koushik Sen, Alex Dimakis, Matei Zaharia (UC Berkeley)

title.zh: Try Before You Evolve（RecRSI）：先短试再全训的推荐模型自改进
title.en: Try Before You Evolve (RecRSI): Short Trials Before Full Retraining for Self-Improving Recommenders

why.zh: 在递归自改进推荐模型时，先给每个候选修改跑一小段真实训练再决定谁值得全量重训，远比让 LLM 评审补丁可靠，因为修改的效果藏在依赖数据的训练行为里，LLM 从代码 diff 上读不出来（LLM 评审与结果甚至负相关）。
why.en: When a recommender improves itself recursively, giving each candidate edit a short real training trial before choosing which one gets a full retrain is far more reliable than an LLM judging the patch, because an edit's effect lives in data-dependent training behaviour an LLM cannot read from a diff (the LLM judge is even negatively correlated with outcomes).

what.zh: 推荐排序的反馈要等完整重训后才有，采样 loss 会误导且无法在改动 loss 的修改之间比较，AlphaEvolve、DeepEvolve、Self-EvolveRec 等智能体 90 次重训只保留 37 次（41%）。
what.en: Ranking feedback only arrives after a full retrain, sampled loss misleads and cannot compare edits that change the loss, and agents such as AlphaEvolve, DeepEvolve and Self-EvolveRec keep only 37 of 90 retrainings (41%).

how.zh: RecRSI 根据诊断提出 3 个修改，每个跑自身全量训练的前几步作为短试，用 probe 用户上的全排序 NDCG@10 打分，只有最好的才全量重训，30 次重训保留 23 次（77%）；测试 NDCG@10 比最强基线高 SASRec +42/+42/+31%、HSTU +18/+102/+16%（CDs、Office、LastFM）。平均增益 +139.2%（LLM 评审 116.9%、随机 43.2%），最差重训回退仅 −5.3%，短试与结果相关 ρ 0.46、AUC 0.71，而 LLM 评审为 ρ −0.14、AUC 0.36；胜者超过父代短试时 13 次中 11 次被采纳，否则 7 次中 2 次，可当早停规则。
how.en: RecRSI proposes three edits from a diagnosis, gives each a short trial made of the first steps of its own full training run scored by full-ranking NDCG@10 on probe users, and fully retrains only the best, keeping 23 of 30 retrainings (77%); test NDCG@10 beats the strongest baseline by +42/+42/+31% on SASRec and +18/+102/+16% on HSTU (CDs, Office, LastFM). Its average gain is +139.2% (LLM judge 116.9%, random 43.2%) with a worst retrained regression of only −5.3%, and the short trial reaches ρ 0.46 and AUC 0.71 against ρ −0.14 and AUC 0.36 for the LLM judge; when the winner beats the parent's trial 11 of 13 retrainings are promoted against 2 of 7 otherwise, which works as an early-stopping rule.

metric.zh: 重训保留率 77% vs 41% · 平均增益 +139.2%
metric.en: Retrains kept 77% vs 41% · avg gain +139.2%

items.authors: Xu Huang, Jiawei Feng, Jiancan Wu et al. (USTC)

title.zh: Aligning Autoresearch：智能体与人类的共同改进（AutoBenchmark、HackBench、AutoInteract、RL-XAR）
title.en: Aligning Autoresearch: Co-Improvement between Agents & Humans (AutoBenchmark, HackBench, AutoInteract, RL-XAR)

why.zh: autoresearch 智能体已经能端到端跑完研究循环，但没有人类指导时造出的基准接近饱和，最强的监控模型也只能定位约三分之二的 reward hack，所以 Meta FAIR 认为让智能体与人类协作（co-improvement）比完全自改进更快也更安全。
why.en: Autoresearch agents can now run the research loop end to end, but without human direction the benchmarks they build are near-saturated and the best monitor localizes only about two-thirds of reward hacks, which is why Meta FAIR argues that agents working with humans (co-improvement) is faster and safer than pure self-improvement.

what.zh: 完全自动的 autoresearch 会刷指标而非真正做研究（reward hacking），在基准设计这类开放任务上缺乏判断力，而且训练时几乎不包含与人类的多轮交互和写作质量信号。
what.en: Fully automatic autoresearch games metrics instead of doing the research (reward hacking), lacks judgment on open-ended tasks such as benchmark design, and is trained with almost no multi-turn human interaction or writing-quality signal.

how.zh: 四部分：AutoBenchmark 让智能体根据求解者轨迹和 LLM 审查迭代造基准，无人类指导时求解者得分超过 80，给出具体的“造什么、怎么造”可把得分减半，而一句话意图几乎无效；HackBench 含 169 条轨迹（41 条真实 hack、128 条注入 hack，中位数超百万字符、264 条命令，hack 命令中位数仅 1 条），最强的 Claude Opus 5 定位 F1 仅 64.88，其他模型除 Muse Wonder（61.47）外都低于 53。AutoInteract 用从真实交互历史学到的用户模拟器生成多轮 RL 数据，把 LiveCodeBench-Pro 平均 Pass@1 从 29.9 提到 43.0（4B）、49.1 提到 55.7（27B）；RL-XAR 元优化 rubric 生成器使专家文本与模型输出的分差最大化，再用这些 rubric 做 RL 改进论文、故事和维基写作。
how.en: Four parts: AutoBenchmark has an agent iterate on a benchmark from solver trajectories and LLM review, and unaided solvers score above 80 while specific direction on what and how to build halves the score and a one-line intent barely helps; HackBench has 169 trajectories (41 natural and 128 injected hacks, median over a million characters and 264 commands, median one hacked command), where the best monitor, Claude Opus 5, reaches only 64.88 F1 and every model except Muse Wonder (61.47) stays below 53. AutoInteract trains on multi-turn RL data built with user simulators learned from real histories and lifts average LiveCodeBench-Pro Pass@1 from 29.9 to 43.0 at 4B and 49.1 to 55.7 at 27B, and RL-XAR meta-optimizes a rubric generator to maximize the gap between expert text and model output, then runs RL against those rubrics to improve paper, story and Wikipedia writing.

metric.zh: HackBench 最佳定位 F1 64.88 · 人类指导使求解分减半
metric.en: HackBench best localization F1 64.88 · human direction halves solver scores

items.authors: Tianjian Li, Chuanyang Jin, Seungone Kim, Tong Chen, … Ilia Kulikov, Jason Weston (FAIR at Meta, JHU, CMU, UW)

title.zh: HarnessPro：带 Pareto 性能-成本选择的递归 harness 自改进
title.en: HarnessPro: Recursive Harness Self-Improvement with Pareto Performance-Cost Selection

why.zh: harness 自改进不必用 token 换准确率：只要把执行成本也作为选择标准并淘汰被 Pareto 支配的候选，进化出的 harness 就会学会砍掉冗余工具调用和冗长输出、同时保留最终验证，因此比 RHO 更准也更便宜。
why.en: Harness self-improvement does not have to buy accuracy with tokens: once execution cost is a selection criterion and Pareto-dominated candidates are dropped, evolved harnesses learn to cut redundant tool calls and verbose output while keeping the final verification, so they end up both more accurate and cheaper than RHO.

what.zh: RHO 等递归 harness 自改进方法主要靠更多探索和更重的验证来提高通过率，导致部署时 token 成本和延迟膨胀。
what.en: Recent recursive harness self-improvement methods such as RHO raise pass rates mainly by exploring more and verifying harder, which inflates token cost and latency in deployment.

how.zh: HarnessPro 用多智能体诊断轨迹、按不同性能-成本优先级规划修改并落实到 harness，在无 ground truth 的 LLM 合成固定测试上评估，淘汰不如初始 harness 或被 Pareto 支配的候选，并保留 Lite/Medium/Heavy 三档继续递归进化（进化出的机制包括按任务配置推理强度和工具预算、在第 14/26 次工具调用时提醒并在第 44 次阻断的运行时 hook、输出压缩）。在 GPT-5.5 + Codex 上 Heavy 档在 Terminal-Bench 2 达 80.8%（RHO 76.3%），单任务成本降 33.9%，Medium 档在 SWE-Bench Pro 以 79.0% 对 80.0% 基本持平 RHO 而成本降 53%，而直接给 RHO 加预算 hook 或统一低推理强度虽省钱却掉点（统一低强度使 Terminal-Bench 2 降到 62.7%），且节省未计入进化过程本身的成本。
how.en: HarnessPro has agents diagnose trajectories, plan edits under different performance-cost priorities and implement them, scores candidates on fixed LLM-synthesized tests without ground truth, drops any candidate worse than the starting harness or Pareto-dominated, and keeps Lite, Medium and Heavy harnesses to evolve further (evolved mechanisms include task profiles for reasoning effort and tool budget, runtime hooks that remind at tool calls 14 and 26 and block at 44, and output compression). With GPT-5.5 and Codex the Heavy harness reaches 80.8% on Terminal-Bench 2 (RHO 76.3%) at 33.9% lower cost per task, the Medium harness roughly matches RHO on SWE-Bench Pro (79.0% against 80.0%) at 53% lower cost, while bolting budget hooks or uniform low reasoning effort onto RHO saves money but loses accuracy (uniform low effort drops Terminal-Bench 2 to 62.7%), and the savings exclude the cost of the evolution run itself.

metric.en: TB2 80.8% (+4.5 pt over RHO) · cost −33.9%

items.authors: Zhuoshi Pan, ZhiYuan Feng, Yukuo Cen, Honglin Lin, Junru Lu, Zhongxia Chen, Shuo Yang, H. Vicky Zhao, Jie Tang (Tsinghua, Z.AI, SJTU, Warwick, Kling AI)

title.zh: Skill∞：会优化自身流程的递归自改进 skill 优化器
title.en: Skill∞: Recursive Self-Improvement for Agent Skill Optimization

why.zh: 让 skill 优化器改写自己的流程之所以有效，是因为自我修改让它学会了要证据：改进后的 meta-skill 只在 rollout 显示目标失败确有进展时才接受打平的候选，于是优化出的 skill 在 SkillsBench 上超过了人工编写的 skill。
why.en: Letting a skill optimizer rewrite its own procedure pays off because the self-edit taught it to demand evidence: the refined meta-skill only accepts a tied candidate when the rollout shows progress on the targeted failure, which lifts its optimized skills above human-curated ones on SkillsBench.

what.zh: SkillOpt、SkillEvolver 等 skill 优化器遵循人工设计的固定流程，一个 skill 优化完学到的经验不会回流，优化器本身从不进步。
what.en: Skill optimizers such as SkillOpt and SkillEvolver follow a hand-designed procedure and carry nothing over from one skill to the next, so the optimizer itself never improves.

how.zh: meta agent 按照一个 meta-skill（通过原生 skill discovery 加载的标准 skill 包）完成检查、诊断轨迹、提出 1–2 个候选、评估、独立审查和决策，并自行分配预算，再把同一循环用于在若干 skill 优化任务上优化 meta-skill 本身，之后跨领域复用（打平候选被选比例从种子版的 83% 降到 54%，meta 分数 0.55→0.83）。在 Codex CLI + GPT-6 Luna、每个 skill 4 个候选预算下，Skill∞ 在 83 个 SkillsBench 任务上达 60.7%，高于人工 skill 56.4%、SkillEvolver 54.5% 和无自改进版 55.9%，KernelBench 平均加速 1.62×（SkillEvolver 1.18×），自改进本身约等于 11 次 skill 优化，摊到 83 个 skill 上额外开销不到 15%。
how.en: A meta agent follows a meta-skill (a standard skill package loaded through native skill discovery) to inspect, diagnose traces, propose one or two candidates, evaluate, get independent review, decide and allocate its own budget, and the same loop is run on the meta-skill itself over several skill-optimization tasks before it is reused across domains (tied candidates are accepted 54% of the time against 83% for the seed, and the meta score rises from 0.55 to 0.83). With Codex CLI, GPT-6 Luna and a budget of four candidates per skill, Skill∞ reaches 60.7% on 83 SkillsBench tasks against 56.4% for human-curated skills, 54.5% for SkillEvolver and 55.9% without self-improvement, gets a 1.62× mean KernelBench speedup (SkillEvolver 1.18×), and the self-improvement costs about eleven skill optimizations, under 15% extra when amortized over 83 skills.

metric.zh: SkillsBench 60.7% · 人工 skill 56.4%
metric.en: SkillsBench 60.7% · human-curated 56.4%

items.authors: Wangcheng Tao, Zhanglu Yan, Han Wu, Weng-Fai Wong (NUS, CityU HK)

title.zh: alphaXiv OpenResearch：把 arxiv 改成 autoarxiv 即可自动复现论文
title.en: alphaXiv OpenResearch: Swap arxiv for autoarxiv to Auto-Reproduce a Paper

why.zh: 复现论文变成改一个网址的事：把 arxiv 换成 autoarxiv 就会把论文开成 OpenResearch 项目，由你自己的编程智能体配环境并跑最小复现，之所以可行是因为每次运行的代码、日志和产物都记录在本地，智能体能据此排错并在自己过去的实验上继续推进。
why.en: Reproducing a paper becomes a one-URL action: swapping arxiv for autoarxiv opens the paper as an OpenResearch project where your own coding agent sets up the environment and runs a minimal reproduction, and it works because every run's code, logs and artifacts are recorded locally so the agent can debug and build on its own past experiments.

what.zh: 论文代码常因环境配置和未锁定依赖而跑不起来，而现有 autoresearch 工具往往把用户绑定在单一模型厂商或云上。
what.en: Most paper code does not run out of the box because of setup work and unpinned dependencies, and autoresearch tools tend to lock users into one model vendor or cloud.

how.zh: OpenResearch（MIT 许可，alphaXiv 出品）是一个开源 meta-harness，可接 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Cursor、Google Antigravity 或经 OpenCode 接本地模型，检索 alphaXiv、bioRxiv、PubMed 文献，把每个项目作为带实验树的 git 仓库并在本地 SQL 数据库中记录运行，算力可选本地、SSH、Slurm、Kubernetes、Modal、Ray、Tinker 或 Hugging Face Jobs。这是一次产品发布而非带基准数字的论文：仓库约 7.7k star，团队称智能体会反复处理版本错误直到最小运行通过，本文只读了帖子、README 和文档，未亲自测试。
how.en: OpenResearch (MIT-licensed, from alphaXiv) is an open meta-harness that wraps Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor or Google Antigravity (or local models through OpenCode), searches alphaXiv, bioRxiv and PubMed, tracks each project as a git repository with an experiment tree recorded in a local SQL database, and runs on local, SSH, Slurm, Kubernetes, Modal, Ray, Tinker or Hugging Face Jobs compute. This is a product launch rather than a paper with benchmarks: the repo has about 7.7k stars, the team says the agent works through version errors until the minimal run passes, and we read only the posts, README and docs without testing it ourselves.

metric.zh: 改一个网址 → 最小复现 · 约 7.7k star
metric.en: one URL change → minimal reproduction · ~7.7k stars

items.authors: alphaXiv

title.zh: RoboAuto：基于多层物理理解的自主机器人程序搜索
title.en: RoboAuto: Autonomous Robot Program Search through Multi-Level Physical Understanding

why.zh: 只看执行反馈的机器人代码搜索会卡住，RoboAuto 之所以有效，是因为它把存下来的物理知识（可供性、空间关系、动作效果）落到实测的场景几何上并逐阶段验证，使朴素的生成-执行-修改循环从 5.2% 提升到 91.2%。
why.en: Robot self-improvement through code search stalls when the agent only reads execution feedback, and RoboAuto works because it grounds stored physical knowledge (affordances, spatial relations, action effects) in measured scene geometry and verifies each stage, lifting a plain generate-execute-revise loop from 5.2% to 91.2%.

what.zh: CaP-Agent0、ASPIRE 等 Code-as-Policy 智能体根据执行轨迹修改机器人程序，却不解决物理层面的问题，会反复尝试不合适的抓取、照搬别的物体的硬编码高度，或在未验证的步骤后继续执行。
what.en: Code-as-Policy agents such as CaP-Agent0 and ASPIRE revise robot programs from execution traces but leave physical questions unresolved, repeating unsuitable grasps, reusing hard-coded heights from other objects, or moving on after an unverified step.

how.zh: RoboAuto 结合三部分：从 LIBERO-90 演示和在线解题中积累的物体物理知识与可执行 skill 的分层知识库、用 Molmo2 和 SAM 3 测量关键物理量的场景 grounding、以及带逐阶段验证和自设实验来检验物理假设的多阶段规划，所有方法均以 Claude Opus 4.6 为编程智能体。它在 LIBERO-PRO Long 达 73.4%（ASPIRE 30.8%）、LIBERO-Plus 达 90.3%（44.7%），知识库让 RoboTwin 2.0 迁移从 24.5% 升到 91.5%，在三个真实 WidowX 任务上取得 95.8–100% 而 π0.5 为 0，但真机上仍需人工重置场景并保障安全。
how.en: RoboAuto combines a hierarchical knowledge base of object-centric physical knowledge and executable skills built from LIBERO-90 demonstrations and online solving, scene grounding with Molmo2 and SAM 3 to measure action-critical quantities, and multi-stage planning with grounded verification and self-designed experiments that test physical hypotheses, with every method using Claude Opus 4.6 as the coding agent.
